earlier_sources: https://github.com/googlefonts/googlefontdirectory-hg at 52f780bc9d197280a9f430574e179a5f233c56b6, ofl/nanumbrushscript/: the font as built and its metadata; src/ holds METADATA_comments.txt, NanumBrush.otf, no source.
disclose: The released font is partly hinted (TrueType instructions in 5093 of 13799 glyphs). These sources carry no TrueType instructions, so the build is hinted by ttfautohint: the outlines, spacing and layout are the release's, its rendering at small sizes under a TrueType interpreter is not. Hinting is not compared by the gates.
